title: Stationarity forces div_M ν = 0 for a smooth unit normal in A₀ (zero mean curvature, parent step 7)
statement: Zero mean curvature. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: U is open; M ⊆ U; dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; M is stationary in U: ∫_M trace(P_x∘DX(x)) dH^m(x) = 0 for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport X ⊆ U (P_x the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x), DX(x) = fderiv ℝ X x, H^m = μHE[m]); ν is C^∞ on some open set O ⊇ M; and for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x. Conclusion: trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0 for every x ∈ M (Dν(x) = fderiv ℝ ν x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ ν x).toLinearMap) = 0
